message: Multiroot session support: `AgentCapabilities.multipleWorkingDirectories` capability (with `immutablePrimary`, which pins `workingDirectories[0]` as a fixed primary root that clients MUST NOT remove or reorder), `CreateSessionParams.workingDirectories` and `SessionMetadata.workingDirectories` (equal-peer set, mirrored onto `SessionState`/`SessionSummary`), `CreateChatParams.workingDirectories` and `ChatState`/`ChatSummary.workingDirectories` (a subset of the session's set), and the client-dispatchable `session/workingDirectorySet` / `session/workingDirectoryRemoved` and `chat/workingDirectorySet` / `chat/workingDirectoryRemoved` actions for mutating those sets.
